note: Every row was read from the vendor's own pages on this date, in a desktop browser for the pages that fill in their prices with JavaScript. Prices are US dollar list prices for one person. A thing the page did not state is recorded as not stated, never guessed. Nothing here was measured by running the rival's software: Docket's own runs are on the page and are marked as ours.

tools.name: Screaming Frog SEO Spider
tools.runs_on: Windows, macOS (Apple silicon and Intel) and Ubuntu
tools.sold: $279 a year per licence; a licence lasts 1 year and then has to be renewed; two users need two licences
tools.urls: no fixed limit on a paid licence: the maximum is "dependent on allocated memory and storage"
tools.wins: raw crawl data, JavaScript rendering and the biggest sites
tools.features: its feature list names JavaScript rendering, scheduling and crawl comparison

tools.name: Sitebulb
tools.runs_on: a desktop app for Windows or Mac, and a separate cloud product
tools.sold: Lite $180 a year for 1 user, Pro $425 a year for 1 user; cloud from $1500 a year
tools.urls: 10,000 URLs per audit on Lite, 500,000 on Pro
tools.wins: client work: Pro lists scheduled audits, audit comparisons and customised PDF reports
tools.features: every plan lists JavaScript crawling and Google Analytics and Search Console integration; Pro adds scheduled audits, audit comparisons and customised PDF reports

tools.name: SEO PowerSuite (WebSite Auditor)
tools.sold: WebSite Auditor Professional $149 a year; the whole Professional suite $349 a year
tools.free: free for as long as you want, crawling and auditing 500 URLs
tools.urls: 500 URLs on the free version, and site crawling and auditing listed as unlimited on a paid licence
tools.refund: the pricing page says refunds are not issued for partial use or for the time left in a subscription
tools.wins: an SEO suite: the same company sells rank tracking, backlink analysis and link building
tools.features: the same company sells Rank Tracker, SEO SpyGlass for backlinks and Link Assistant for link building

tools.name: Netpeak Spider
tools.sold: $20 a month, cancel anytime, after a 3 day free trial
tools.urls: not stated on the pages read
tools.refund: the pricing page lists a 14 day money back guarantee
tools.wins: paying by the month with no yearly commitment, on Windows or a Mac
tools.features: crawls JavaScript with Chromium and has a built-in PageRank calculator

tools.name: Scrutiny
tools.runs_on: Mac only: macOS 11.5 or later, and the page says there are no plans for Windows
tools.free: 30 days of free use with only exporting disabled
tools.urls: not stated on the page read
tools.wins: a one-off price on a Mac, and a crawler that also checks spelling and validates HTML
tools.features: link checking, HTML validation, spelling and grammar checks, SEO warnings and sitemap export

tools.name: LibreCrawl
tools.runs_on: any computer that can run Docker or Python, as a web app you open in your browser
tools.sold: free and open source under the MIT licence
tools.urls: not stated on the page read
tools.wins: costing nothing, and being software you can read and change
tools.features: JavaScript rendering through Playwright, PageSpeed Insights integration, issue detection and CSV, XLSX, JSON or XML export
tools.note: GitHub lists no published release, so it is started from the source
